name: cf-browser-launcher
description: Open .cfm files against your local Adobe ColdFusion server in a browser of your choice.

cfBrowserLauncher.serverHost.description: Adobe ColdFusion server host and port by default: http://localhost:8500

cfBrowserLauncher.documentRoot.description: Absolute path on disk that corresponds to a single CF project's root, for example: C:\ColdFusion2025\cfusion\wwwroot\my-project. Leave empty to auto-detect it as the root of the workspace folder that contains the file you right-clicked (recommended, works with multi-root workspaces where each root is a different CF project).

cfBrowserLauncher.projectName.description: Project name used as the URL segment right after serverHost, e.g. the 'my-project' in http://localhost:8500/my-project/file.cfm. Leave empty to auto-detect it from the name of the resolved document root folder (recommended).

cfBrowserLauncher.defaultBrowser.description: Key (within 'browsers') used by the quick command 'Open in Chromium (ColdFusion)'.

cfBrowserLauncher.browsers.description: Map of name -> absolute path of each installed browser's executable. Adjust the paths to match your machine.
